_about: REVIEWED EXCLUSIONS of accepted answers for Arabic lemma cards (2026-11-26). A key is "<vocalized head>|<POS>"; each string is a whole alternative (case-insensitive) that GoReview neither shows nor accepts for that lexeme, although the dictionary entry lists it. Decided by the auditor, confirmed by the lead: قَالَ|VERB, "to root": on its own it means to plant roots in English, a false meaning for a learner who types it ("to advocate", "to propound" stay). A test fails if a key is no lemma of the index.
